snippet.title: 10 Years of Minecraft!
snippet.description:
We've built a huge new map to celebrate 10 Years of Minecraft! Witness the history of Minecraft from its humble beginnings, wander the Mob Garden, explore glorious Redstone Contraptions, and much more. Keep an eye out for hidden Easter eggs and secrets. Available for free in Java and Bedrock.

Bedrock: https://marketplace.minecraft.net/en-us/pdp?id=d87ec9cd-5dec-4308-a03c-00d3cdf9b2b0

Music: Drive Drive Drive by Loving Caliber

Java: https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraft/attachments/10%20Years%20of%20Minecraft.zip
